name: order_thyroid_panel
description: Orders a thyroid function panel including TSH, free T4, free T3, and optionally thyroid antibodies (anti-TPO, anti-thyroglobulin). Evaluates thyroid function for hypo- and hyperthyroidism.

include_antibodies.description: Whether to include thyroid antibody tests

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering thyroid panel

known_condition.description: Known thyroid condition if any (e.g., hypothyroid, hyperthyroid, none)

when_to_use: Symptoms of hypothyroidism (fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance)
Symptoms of hyperthyroidism (weight loss, palpitations, heat intolerance)
